# Deprecated surface

This document lists the driver's deprecated API, grouped by the compat
build-tag bundle it belongs to. It is generated from the source; see
[the deprecation and removal policy](DEPRECATIONS.md) for how the lifecycle
and the `go_hdb_compat_go1_NN` build tags work.

## Bundle `go_hdb_compat_go1_28`

- Compiled by default through Go 1.27; set `-tags go_hdb_compat_go1_28` to exclude it (opt-out self-check).
- Opt-in on Go 1.28: excluded by default, set `-tags go_hdb_compat_go1_28` to include it.
- Removed in Go 1.29.

### NullBytes

```go
type NullBytes
```

NullBytes represents an []byte that may be null.

Deprecated: []byte is already null-aware — database/sql represents a SQL NULL
as a nil []byte, so a wrapper adds nothing. Scan into a plain []byte (nil on
NULL), or use sql.Null[[]byte] if you want an explicit Valid flag.
